stemMd: A vehicle travels 120 km at 6 litres per 100 km and 80 km at 9 litres per 100 km. What is its overall fuel consumption in litres per 100 km?
explanationMd: Each segment uses 7.2 litres, for 14.4 litres across 200 km. Per 100 km, consumption is 7.2 litres. Weight fuel rates by distance.

distractorRationale.d: This uses only the second segment.
distractorRationale.a: This uses only the first segment.
distractorRationale.c: This averages rates equally despite unequal distances.
